report.md.footer:
**Headless covers nothing graphical and nothing input related.** Under `-nographics` the
texture atlas injection never runs, and menus, keys and controllers are never touched. A
version belongs on the list only once a GUI run exists as well, the configured evidence is
in its log AND a human has confirmed the visual check. That confirmation is bound to the
mod version and expires with the next release.
